verdict.rationale: Muse offers user-controlled, scoped access grants (per-service linking, approval cards for actions, secure credential storage, and one-time-use virtual cards via Stripe Link that hide real payment details) which function as a least-privilege mechanism, but there is no evidence of a formal API-credential/token-issuance system for programmatic or scoped agent-to-agent access as a developer-facing feature. missing for 10: explicit scoped API-key/token issuance mechanism, developer documentation on credential scopes, independent verification that access grants are enforced with fine-grained least-privilege boundaries.
